tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

Achieved in at least two financial years out of last 3 years i.e. between 2023-24 to 2025-26 a minimum turnover of not less than 50 percent of Project cost. In support of this, the Tenderer shall furnish a Certificate duly attested by a Chartered Accountant along with Technical Bid

The Tenderer shall have experience of similar nature of works in last three years i.e. between 2023-24 to 2025-26 of not less than 50 percent of Project cost. In support of this, the Tenderer shall furnish a Work Completion Certificate duly certified by the Competent Authority not less than the rank of Executive Engineer along with Technical Bid
Consultants must have a valid ISO certificate as consultancy services provider from Government approved/ registered Firm
Consultant should insured against all risks. Shall be specified by providing ESI certificate and EPF certificates
Consultant should provide with latest Valid GST certificate which should be submitted as proof
joint Tenders are not allowed. The offer of the Consultant, who does not qualify for the above pre qualification norms, will not be considered for further evaluation
Past experience and Quality of services of tenderer will be considered for evaluation and will be rejected if found bad record
Availibilty of required equipments with tenderer
ESI EPF Certificate along with last three year paid challan copy
Right to accept or reject the tender rests with the Commissioner, Hubballi-Dharwad Urban Development Authority, Hubballi
All other conditions are as per tender Document
